Engagement Ring Shopper Leads

CaratBase delivers verified local leads to independent jewellers, estate buyers and appraisers. First 3 leads are free, then $40 per accepted lead.

What you get

• First 3 leads free • $40 per accepted lead • Optional $29/month valuation widget

Why CaratBase

Independent jewellers can focus on sales while CaratBase supplies ready‑to‑buy customers. The leads are locally verified, ensuring high conversion rates.

FAQ

How do I receive the leads? Leads are delivered directly to your email or CRM via our API.

Is there a minimum commitment? No, you pay only for the leads you accept; the first 3 are free.
